record.rationale: Browser composition binds actual native items and script-query producers at the existing plain-cell display boundary.
responsibilities: Task6PMYVV connects the actual shared Writer FontNameSelect to native Calc CharFontName10007,complete SvxFontItem values,source script selection,actual pattern/history owners and real ODS font declarations. Pinned ICU78.3 property data and original consumed scalar algorithms match compiled original block/script/editing-class observations for every Unicode codepoint. The compiled witness uses an explicitly constrained SCRIPT dispatcher bootstrap;it is not a full ICU or LibreOffice service certificate. Source BreakIterator script runs retain the initial-NUL cache quirk. The browser binds its current plain-cell display to the consumed XBreakIterator script port and GetStringScriptType loop;it does not emulate native formatted-cell caches or the UNO factory. Shared selection carries all five font fields. Writer family operations,caret item queries and pending items preserve native items instead of flattening them through browser projections. Actual ODS pools/contexts retain independent script fonts and optional styles.xml declarations. Task37 verification covers only the documented font UI/native-item slice;no broad parity flags are promoted.

Task89YNKC connects native grow/shrink slots11042/11043, complete typed font-height requests and shared SvxScriptSetItem to real script-specific selection patterns, attribute history, ODS and browser glyph spans. Native mixed/default/invalid states, unsigned growth/signed shrink limits, metadata reset, identical-format history, disjoint marks and whole-sheet data-area query clipping are retained. Default formatobjectbar Grow/Shrink placements remain hidden as upstream. Existing Writer font/menu/toolbar controls and primary-save/open/no-recovery deviations remain. Native rich edit, filtered/alternate sheet views, device text metrics, full pool-cache/border services and complete application parity are not claimed.

TaskJT4A81 restores the original complete RowHeightContext six-input contract,independent PPTX/PPTY and zoom values,opaque borrowed device identity,zero/false defaults and UInt16 extra-height storage. ScScriptTypeData owns a lazy XBreakIterator reference per document. The original process-context creation dependency is an explicit borrowed host factory:the browser supplies the existing real BreakIteratorImpl;Calc core imports only the interface. Empty host references can be retried;the empty-string guard and source script loop are preserved. Calc existing font-selection UI now uses that document owner and ScGlobal office-UI-language fallback. Original address-only cached GetScriptType/SetScriptType traverse actual document/table/column CellTextAttr storage,retain UNKNOWN and do not synthesize missing metadata or columns(CALC238). Formatted-cell UpdateScriptType/GetRangeScriptType and actual GetNeededSize/EditEngine automatic wrapped-height layout remain unported. The existing Writer DOM Range algorithm is moved unchanged into shared VCL;Writer retains source node offsets,twip geometry and fallback policy. No browser document model,synthetic row heights or UNO/OutputDevice emulator is added. Full native device/font/ABI/layout and full UI parity remain unverified.
